# endpointcentral_mdm_device (Data Source)

Looks up one enrolled MDM device by name or serial number, for its ID (`endpointcentral_mdm_group_membership`). Removed devices are ignored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "endpointcentral_mdm_device" "by_name" {
  name = "mac-lab-02"
}

data "endpointcentral_mdm_device" "by_serial" {
  serial_number = "VMSERIAL002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Device name (case-insensitive).
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) MDM device ID.
- `model` (String)
- `udid` (String)
